sloka: स रामम् सर्व कामैअः तम् भरद्वाजः प्रिय अतिथिम् ।सभार्यम् सह च भ्रात्रा प्रतिजग्राह धर्मवित् ॥२-५४-३३॥
transliteration: sa rāmam sarva kāmaiaḥ tam bharadvājaḥ priya atithim ।sabhāryam saha ca bhrātrā pratijagrāha dharmavit ॥2-54-33॥

translations.english: Bharadwaja, who knows his duty honoured Rama, his beloved guest with his consort and brother by extending all kinds of hospitality.
